title: Verify: Committed manifest paths vs present files with fs mocked unit tests
summary: Unit tests for findMissingAssetPaths using the committed manifest read through mocked node:fs.
description: New test file tests/manifestFilesMocked.test.ts mocks node:fs, serves the committed manifest.json text via the mock, and asserts the helper against a file list.
acceptance_criteria: Full list yields no missing paths
List missing one path yields exactly that path
fs is mocked and no asset file is read
technical_constraints: vi.mock('node:fs'); committed manifest text obtained via vi.importActual('node:fs') once in a hoisted factory, or imported as JSON
definition_of_done: Test file passes via vitest filter

steps.symbol: new: committed manifest paths are all in the file list
steps.action: Create the test: mock node:fs with readFileSync returning the committed manifest.json text (obtained via vi.importActual in the mock factory) and existsSync mocked; call parseManifest on JSON.parse(readFileSync(...)); build files = manifest.assets.map(a=>a.path); assert findMissingAssetPaths(manifest, files) equals [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestFilesMocked.test.ts

steps.symbol: new: reports a path missing from the file list
